findings.title: createPatch array diff allocates an O(n*m) table with no size guard
findings.why: diffArrays builds a Uint32Array of (n+1)*(m+1) entries over the differing middle section of the two arrays, and calls deepEqual for every pair of elements. Two large arrays that differ throughout, such as two different 50k-element arrays, need a table of about 10 GB. createPatch then throws a RangeError or runs out of memory instead of returning a patch. A fallback is needed for large inputs, such as a plain replace of the array.
